proposition: On the record reviewed in C-467/25 P, D&A Pharma did not establish an appellate basis requiring reversal of the General Court's conclusion on interest in bringing proceedings, so the appeal was dismissed in full.
scope_note: This is a narrow appellate-procedure proposition. It is not a proposition about medicinal-product efficacy, safety, scientific validity, or the correctness of every CHMP/EMA statement.
